notes: §1985:XIV.3.1.3 SR1: "Cd-name-1 must reference an input CD." BindAcceptMessageCount resolves the word through ResolveCommunicationCd with AcceptRule (formats [Input]), which refuses with COBOL6170 a name that is no cd-name of this program and a CD of another format; cd-names are local to their program (§1985:X.1.3.8). The witness refuses ACCEPT of an output CD. Probes at --std 85: (b) an I-O CD refused COBOL6170; a data-name of the CD refused COBOL6170; an undeclared name refused; a containing program's input CD named from a nested program refused COBOL6170 (cd-name scope is its program); no operand refused COBOL0901; two cd-names refused COBOL5506; an ON EXCEPTION phrase refused COBOL2269. (d) an input CD with MESSAGE omitted (it is not underlined) accepted and ran, printing ST=20 MC=000099; with MESSAGE printed ST=20 MC=000000. (c) --std 2023 refuses the section (COBOL0902). (a, e, f) not reached: the operand is a cd-name. Every refusal's text cites ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex A rather than the 1985 rule, the cross-cutting citation matter kb/Work PB4950 decides; the outcome is the one the rule requires.

next.reason: 1985: "Cd-name-1 must reference an input CD."; 2023: "No candidate covers ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT or CDs; the 2023 ACCEPT rules address other formats only.". The Communication module and ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT are absent from 2023. The 2023 ACCEPT rules cover only identifiers, screens and devices, not CDs.
